title: Pulumi ESC: root-level `accessToken` deprecated — use `auth.accessToken`
remediation: Move `spec.provider.pulumi.accessToken` under `spec.provider.pulumi.auth.accessToken` on each store named.
verifyCommand: kubectl get secretstores.external-secrets.io,clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.provider | has("pulumi")) | select(.spec.provider.pulumi.accessToken != null) | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row still sets the root-level accessToken
coversNotes: pulumi.md › Using Access Token › Note: The deprecated accessToken field at the root level is sti

title: Helm chart: `scopedRBAC: true` without `scopedNamespace` now scopes to the release namespace

detection.reason: Helm values are not collected; the controller's args are

quote: feat(charts): default scopedNamespace to .Release.Namespace when scopedRBAC is true
remediation: If the release sets `scopedRBAC: true` without `scopedNamespace`: before 2.5 that combination did nothing and the install was cluster-wide. From 2.5 the controller watches only the release namespace (`--namespace=<release ns>`) with namespaced RBAC there, AND the ClusterSecretStore, ClusterExternalSecret and ClusterPushSecret reconcilers are switched off, so ExternalSecrets in other namespaces and every cluster-scoped object stop syncing. Set `scopedRBAC: false` to keep the cluster-wide behaviour you had; setting `scopedNamespace` does not restore it.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(any(.spec.template.spec.containers[]; .image | test("(^|/)(external-secrets/external-secrets|bitnami/external-secrets)([:@]|$)"))) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name) \([.spec.template.spec.containers[].args[]?] | map(select(test("^--namespace|^--enable-cluster"))) | join(" "))"'  # each row shows the namespace scope the controller runs with
coversNotes: v2.5.0 (General): fix(charts): remove stale args guard in controller deployment
